The Miacademy & MiaPrep Learning Channel features a broad selection of learning videos for K-12. We hope you are enjoying them!

Our videos are carefully curated by licensed educators and new videos are added regularly. For more in-depth learning, check out our sites, Miacademy.co and MiaPrep.com, online learning platforms with lessons and practice that go along with our videos.  

Miacademy & MiaPrep also offer many hands-on learning activities including a business simulation, writing in the Miacademy Weekly, and creating artwork. Teaching social skills is also one of the key values at Miacademy. On the site, kids can interact safely in a moderated environment and share their artwork, videos, and ideas with each other.

Homeschoolers, Parents, Teachers, or anyone with kids in grades K-8,  check out https://www.parents.miacademy.co/ and use coupon code VIDEOSPECIAL for a discount. For high school, check out our sister website, https://miaprep.com/
